expected: the Jevellan web app "LJ5 nightly fix missed cutoff" screen at desktop-dark, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "LJ5 Nightly reviews, merges one fix before cutoff, reruns the suite and gates deploy"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: Sidebar session titles are cut off with ellipses ('Context · J11 memory journ…', 'Context · Mesh journey fixt…'), and their subtitle lines are cut off too ('dev-ma…', 'de…').
The 'Nightly window finished' cards cut off their last line ('Deploy: done…'), so the full status can't be read without expanding the card.

The Goals card at the bottom of the right column runs to the edge of the capture. Its 'Pause', 'Edit' and 'Mark done' buttons sit at the very bottom and look slightly clipped, though they can probably still be reached by scrolling.
Many repeated 'Noted.' replies plus duplicated nightly window, review and job cards make the timeline long and repetitive.
The banner reads 'Last night: 3 of 3 nightly tasks passed.' and PR #2 shows as merged. That doesn't obviously signal a 'missed cutoff' state, though this is about the content, not the rendering.
